subject: general
question: The Republic Day parade is held every year at Kartavya Path, in which of the following cities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Republic Day parade is held annually on January 26 at **Kartavya Path (formerly Rajpath)** in New Delhi, India.
 
• New Delhi, the capital city of India, serves as the central venue for national celebrations like Republic Day and Independence Day.
 
• The parade showcases India's military strength, cultural diversity, and achievements, including tableaus from various states and ministries.
 
• The President of India presides over the parade, which begins with the hoisting of the national flag and a 21-gun salute.
 
• The event is attended by dignitaries, including the Prime Minister, foreign guests, and citizens, emphasizing India’s unity and pride.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kartavya Path:** Renamed from Rajpath in September 2022 to emphasize the spirit of duty and responsibility as part of India's democratic ethos.
 
• **Republic Day:** Marks the adoption of the Indian Constitution on January 26, 1950, replacing the Government of India Act 1935 as the governing document.
 
• **Tableaus:** Unique floats representing the cultural heritage, achievements, and schemes of Indian states and ministries are an integral part of the parade.
 
• **Military Display:** Includes marches by regiments of the Indian Armed Forces, showcasing advanced weaponry, tanks, aircraft, and other defense capabilities.
 
• **Chief Guest:** A tradition to invite a foreign dignitary as the chief guest to the Republic Day celebrations to strengthen diplomatic ties and showcase India's hospitality.
